description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 28.03.2016 to 03.04.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how foreign currency conversions will be handled for customs purposes. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
